thread:
Ava: Heads-up — NorthWind Analytics agreed to a short customer piece tied to our benchmark webinar. Need interview date, exact quote lines, legal clearance, and an embargo window. Draft brief: https://intranet.redwood/northwind-case (request access if needed)

Diego: I'll schedule the interview. Customer prefers morning PST. 25-min recording + 10-min follow-up ok?

Rina: Yes. We'll ask for a 2-sentence business outcome quote and one technical soundbite about latency vs prior infra. Also confirm whether they're comfortable with us sharing a single example metric (95th pct).

Ava: Timeline: webinar = 2024-12-10. Legal needs final quote text by 2024-11-30. Marketing needs approved copy by 2024-12-02 to finalize slides + social.

LegalBot: Add exact quote lines to the doc and get customer attestation for metrics. Legal checklist: consent to publish metric, embargo end date, logo usage, and any PHI disclaimers. Send approvals to legal@redwood.com. Customer redlines must be returned within 48h to preserve launch.

Diego: Added slots Tue/Wed next week and a short interview guide to the doc. Sending calendar invite to contact (casey@northwind.com). Recording OK? :microphone:

Rina: Recording OK. Ops: please validate numbers for cost-per-1k and 95p latency so we can quote exacts. ops-infra, can you paste a 1-line attestation template the customer can sign?

ops-infra: Verified numbers will be added to the doc. Suggested attestation: "We confirm the quoted performance metrics reflect NorthWind Analytics' production workload on the stated configuration." Paste back if you want edits.

Ava: Embargo: customer requested social embargo until 2024-12-24. Legal, is that acceptable?

LegalBot: OK with 2024-12-24 embargo provided attestation and final copy received by 2024-11-30. If the customer requests substantial redlines, we may need to delay.

Diego: Lead routing: after publish, route inbound interest to SFDC queue `CS-Inbound` and tag leads with `case:northwind-analytics`. Also add nurture flow `HS-Benchmark-Interest`. Ava, confirm priority?

Ava: Set priority = high for AE follow-up. Also request demo clip? Customer declined live demo but offered a 90-second recorded snippet showing query dashboard. Will require NDA addendum for footage. I'll handle NDA ask.

Rina: I'll own copy and the 1-line technical quote. Diego will own scheduling and collecting the attestation. ops-infra, please drop numbers in by EOD tomorrow.

ops-infra: Numbers posted and signed off in the doc.

Ava: Great — keeping this thread as single timeline. If anything blocks legal signoff, ping LegalBot and @Ava directly. :white_check_mark:
